name: Cheesy coleslaw with wholemeal pitta
source: UK Government Lunchbox Recipe Booklet (NHS/PHE)
description: Crunchy, cheesy coleslaw in a pitta. Serve with cherry tomatoes and a small box of raisins.
ingredients: 1 thin slice of white cabbage, shredded
2 spring onions or a slice of onion, chopped
20g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, finely chopped or grated
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (pitta bread) and milk (cheese, yoghurt). Egg-free, nut-free, soya-free as written.

name: Creamy hummus dip with pitta bread and vegetable sticks
source: UK Government Lunchbox Recipe Booklet (NHS/PHE)
description: Creamy chickpea dip, fun to eat, with pitta strips and vegetable sticks. Works well with a banana and a pot of sugar-free jelly.
ingredients: 1 large wholemeal pitta bread, cut into strips
1 stick of celery, cut into sticks
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (pitta), milk (yoghurt), and celery (celery sticks). Nut-free, egg-free, fish-free, soya-free.
method_steps: Put the chickpeas, lemon juice, yoghurt, oil, spices and garlic in a bowl.
Using a hand blender, mix together until smooth. Can be made the night before and stored in the fridge.
Serve with the pitta bread strips and carrot and celery sticks.
cultural_context: British/Western lunchbox style, Middle Eastern-inspired hummus

name: Egg mayonnaise and lettuce bap
source: UK Government Lunchbox Recipe Booklet (NHS/PHE)
description: Eggs are a great source of protein for growing kids. Works well with cherry tomatoes and a fruit snack pot.
ingredients: small wedge of lettuce, to give 2 tablespoons when shredded
extras_suggested: fruit snack pot (tinned fruit in juice)
allergen_notes: Contains egg and wheat (bap). Mayonnaise typically contains egg too. Milk-free, nut-free, fish-free, soya-free as written.
method_steps: Place the egg in a small saucepan covered with water, bring to the boil and cook for 10 minutes. Plunge in cold water and leave to cool. Can be cooked the night before.
Remove shell and mash the egg with the mayonnaise and pepper.
Use to fill the bap, topping with the lettuce. Try cress or baby spinach instead of lettuce.

name: Hummus and salad wrap
source: UK Government Lunchbox Recipe Booklet (NHS/PHE)
description: Simple to make and fun to eat. Try serving with cherry tomatoes and mixed berries with low-fat Greek style yoghurt.
ingredients: small wedge of lettuce, to give 2 tablespoons when shredded
extras_suggested: 2 tablespoons frozen mixed berries and 3 tablespoons low-fat Greek style yoghurt
150ml fruit juice drink (no added sugar) or 200ml water
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (wrap) and typically sesame (hummus is made from tahini/sesame paste, declare if shop-bought). Egg-free, milk-free (check hummus brand), nut-free, fish-free.
method_steps: Spread the hummus over the wrap, then sprinkle on the carrot and lettuce.
Fold opposite edges of the wrap, then roll up and cut in half.
cultural_context: British/Western lunchbox style, Middle Eastern-inspired hummus

name: Salmon and salad bagel
source: UK Government Lunchbox Recipe Booklet (NHS/PHE)
description: Bagels are popular with kids, a good way to introduce fish. Works well with grapes and a plain rice cake.
ingredients: small can (105g) or half a large can of pink salmon
small wedge of lettuce, to give 2 tablespoons when shredded
allergen_notes: Contains fish (salmon), wheat (bagel), and likely egg (mayonnaise). Milk-free, nut-free, soya-free, sesame-free, crustacean-free, mollusc-free.
method_steps: Cut the bagel in half, toast and leave to cool.
Drain the salmon and remove the bones. Mix with the mayonnaise and pepper. Tinned salmon bones are edible and contain calcium, but remove if your child doesn't like the texture.
Spread the mixture on one half of the bagel, add cucumber and lettuce, then top with the other half.

name: Soft cheese and salad sandwich
source: UK Government Lunchbox Recipe Booklet (NHS/PHE)
description: A quick and easy sandwich to provide dairy in your child's lunchbox. Works well with an apple and a fruit teacake.
ingredients: 20g celery (about two-thirds of a stick), finely chopped
small wedge of lettuce, to give 2 tablespoons when shredded
pinch of black pepper or paprika, optional
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (bread), milk (soft cheese), and celery. Egg-free, nut-free, fish-free, soya-free.
method_steps: Spread both slices of bread with the cheese (helps prevent a soggy sandwich).
Pat the salad dry and use to fill the sandwich, sprinkling with pepper or paprika if using.

name: Spicy chicken and salad wrap
source: UK Government Lunchbox Recipe Booklet (NHS/PHE)
description: Wraps are a popular alternative to sandwiches. Complete with homemade popcorn and fresh fruit.
ingredients: large pinch of chilli powder, to taste
85g cooked chicken breast, chopped into small pieces
small wedge of lettuce, to give 2 tablespoons when shredded
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (wrap) and milk (yoghurt). Highest protein recipe in this set. Egg-free, nut-free, fish-free, soya-free.
method_steps: Mix the yoghurt and spices to taste and add the chicken (great way to use leftover roast chicken).
Spread the chicken mixture on the wrap, then sprinkle on lettuce, cucumber and pepper.
Fold opposite edges of the wrap, then roll up and cut in half.
cultural_context: British/Western lunchbox style with curry-spiced filling

name: Tuna and bean salad
source: UK Government Lunchbox Recipe Booklet (NHS/PHE)
description: A colourful salad, a good way to include fish in your child's lunchbox. Works well with malt loaf and a satsuma.
ingredients: large pinch of dried mixed herbs
1 heaped tablespoon canned mixed beans in water, drained
half a 160g can of tuna in spring water, drained
1 thick slice of wholemeal bread and lower-fat spread
allergen_notes: Contains fish (tuna), wheat (bread), and mustard (mustard powder). Milk-free, egg-free, nut-free, soya-free, crustacean-free.
method_steps: Mix the oil, lemon juice, mixed herbs, mustard powder and black pepper.
Add to the salad vegetables, beans and tuna and mix gently. (Double the recipe to use the rest of the tuna can.)
Serve with the bread and lower-fat spread. Can also be served with cold pasta instead of bread.

name: Tuna mayonnaise and sweetcorn sandwich
source: UK Government Lunchbox Recipe Booklet (NHS/PHE)
description: Mild flavour of tinned tuna combined with sweetcorn. Works well with carrot/cucumber sticks and mixed berries.
ingredients: half a 160g can of tuna in spring water, drained
1 heaped tablespoon sweetcorn (tinned, or cooked from frozen)
extras_suggested: 1 small carrot and a 3cm chunk of cucumber, cut into sticks
allergen_notes: Contains fish (tuna), wheat (bread), and likely egg (mayonnaise). Milk-free, nut-free, soya-free.
method_steps: Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise, sweetcorn and pepper. Can be made the night before.
Sandwich the mixture between the slices of bread.

name: Traditional Peanut Butter and Jelly
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Traditional Peanut Butter and Jelly. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 4). Virginia Cooperative Extension.
description: Peanut butter and jelly sandwich on whole-wheat bread with carrot sticks, apple slices, and low-fat milk. A classic budget-friendly lunchbox staple.
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (bread) and peanuts (peanut butter). Use sunflower seed butter for peanut-free schools. Milk-free, egg-free as written.

name: Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 5). Virginia Cooperative Extension. Adapted from Virginia Family Nutrition Program Chicken Noodle Soup.
description: Savory homemade chicken noodle soup — great as a dinner and packed lunch the next day. Uses whole-wheat noodles and fresh vegetables.
ingredients: 3-pound whole chicken (or 12 ounces canned white meat chicken, drained)
Salt and ground black pepper to taste
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (noodles) and celery. Milk-free, egg-free, fish-free, nut-free as written.
cultural_context: Classic American family meal / school lunchbox leftover

name: English Muffin Mini Pizza
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)

description: Whole-wheat English muffin topped with pizza sauce, reduced-fat cheddar cheese, and diced green pepper. Fun, customisable kid favourite.
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (muffin) and milk (cheese). Egg-free, fish-free, nut-free, soya-free.

name: Black Beans and Rice
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Black Beans and Rice. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 7). Virginia Cooperative Extension. Adapted from Virginia Family Nutrition Program Southwestern Beans and Rice.
description: Hearty black beans with brown rice, canned tomatoes, green beans, onion, and green pepper. High-fibre, plant-based protein.
ingredients: 15 ounces canned black beans, drained and rinsed
15 ounces canned low sodium diced tomatoes
2-15 ounce cans no added salt green beans, trimmed
allergen_notes: Free from all 14 major allergens as written. Suitable for most restrictions.

name: Simply Baked Chicken Drumstick with Mashed Potatoes
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Simply Baked Chicken Drumstick. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 8). Virginia Cooperative Extension.
description: Baked chicken drumsticks with mashed potatoes made with low-fat milk and butter, served with canned green peas. Simple, high-protein leftover-friendly meal.
ingredients: 2-15 ounce cans no salt added green peas
allergen_notes: Contains milk (mashed potato uses milk and butter). Egg-free, fish-free, nut-free, gluten-free.

name: Turkey Burrito
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Turkey Burrito. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 10). Virginia Cooperative Extension.
description: Ground turkey with black beans, corn, and salsa wrapped in a whole-wheat tortilla with romaine lettuce and low-fat cheese.
ingredients: 15 ounces canned black beans, drained and rinsed
15 ounces canned no salt added corn, drained
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (tortillas) and milk (cheese). Egg-free, nut-free, fish-free.

name: French Toast with Carrots and Almonds
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). French Toast. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 11). Virginia Cooperative Extension. Adapted from Virginia Family Nutrition Program French Toast with Fruit Sauce.
description: Cinnamon-vanilla whole-wheat French toast, made with eggs and low-fat milk. Packed with baby carrots and unsalted almonds.
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (bread), egg, milk, and nuts (almonds in pack-with). Highly allergenic — check all restrictions.

name: Pulled Pork Barbeque with Cornbread
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Pulled Pork Barbeque. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 12). Virginia Cooperative Extension. Adapted from Virginia Family Nutrition Program Barbeque Pork Chops.
description: Slow-cooker pulled pork shoulder with vinegar, Worcestershire, and spices, served with cornbread and lima beans.
ingredients: 3 pounds pork shoulder roast, visible fat removed
2-15 ounce cans no salt added lima beans, drained
allergen_notes: Contains gluten (cornbread). Milk-free, egg-free, fish-free, nut-free as written. Check cornbread brand for additional allergens.

name: Whole-Wheat Pita Pocket with Hummus
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)

description: Whole-wheat pita filled with hummus and green pepper strips. Quick, flexible, kid-friendly with endless filling variations.
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (pita) and sesame (hummus contains tahini). Milk-free, egg-free, fish-free, nut-free.

name: Creamy Chicken Salad with Crackers
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Creamy Chicken Salad. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 14). Virginia Cooperative Extension. Adapted from Virginia Family Nutrition Program Chicken Salad.
description: Diced chicken breast with red onion, celery, and light mayo. Served with whole-grain crackers and grapes for dipping fun.
ingredients: 2-2.5 cups boneless skinless chicken breast, cooked and diced (or 12 ounces canned white meat chicken, drained)
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (crackers), egg (mayonnaise), and celery. Milk-free, fish-free, nut-free.

name: Chef Salad with Italian Dressing
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Chef Salad. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 16). Virginia Cooperative Extension. Adapted from Virginia Family Nutrition Program Homemade Italian Dressing.
description: Romaine lettuce with diced low-sodium deli turkey and/or ham, reduced-fat cheddar, cherry tomatoes, and homemade Italian dressing.
ingredients: 1.5 ounces low sodium deli turkey and/or ham, diced
2 tablespoons homemade Italian dressing (water, vinegar, olive oil, Parmesan, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, celery salt, black pepper)
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (crackers, dressing), milk (cheese, Parmesan), celery (celery salt in dressing). Egg-free, nut-free, fish-free.

source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)

ingredients: 1/2 avocado, diced (optional, add lemon juice to prevent browning)
allergen_notes: Contains sesame (hummus/tahini). Milk-free, egg-free, fish-free, nut-free, gluten-free.

ingredients: 1 ounce low sodium deli turkey or ham
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (tortilla) and milk (cheese). Egg-free, nut-free, fish-free.

source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)

allergen_notes: Contains egg (hard-boiled eggs), wheat (pretzels), sesame (hummus/tahini). Milk-free, fish-free, nut-free.

ingredients: 2 tablespoons canned no salt added corn
allergen_notes: Contains milk (sour cream). Egg-free, fish-free, nut-free, gluten-free.

name: Spaghetti and Broccoli with Ground Beef
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Spaghetti and Broccoli. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 22). Virginia Cooperative Extension. Adapted from Virginia Family Nutrition Program Tomato Beef and Noodle Dinner.
description: Whole-wheat spaghetti with lean ground beef, canned low-sodium tomatoes, and fresh broccoli. High-fibre, high-protein leftover-friendly meal.
ingredients: 48 ounces canned low sodium diced tomatoes
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (spaghetti). Milk-free, egg-free, nut-free, fish-free.

name: Yogurt Parfait with Granola and Strawberries
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Yogurt Parfait. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 23). Virginia Cooperative Extension.
description: Low-fat vanilla yogurt layered with fresh strawberries and low-fat granola. Paired with sugar snap peas for a balanced lunch.
allergen_notes: Contains milk (yogurt) and cereals/oats (granola). Check granola brand for nuts. Egg-free, fish-free.

source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)

ingredients: 4 ounces boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced into thin strips
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (noodles), soy (soy sauce), and celery. Milk-free, egg-free, fish-free, nut-free.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich with Tomato Soup
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Grilled Cheese Sandwich. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 25). Virginia Cooperative Extension.
description: Classic grilled cheddar cheese sandwich on whole-wheat bread with low-sodium canned tomato soup. Paired with diced cantaloupe.
allergen_notes: Contains wheat (bread) and milk (cheese). Egg-free, nut-free, fish-free. Tomato soup may contain celery; check label.

name: Whole-Grain Cereal and Milk
source: PACK-IT Cookbook, Virginia Cooperative Extension (Farris, A., Virginia Tech)
citation: Farris, A. (n.d.). Cereal and Milk. In PACK-IT Cookbook (p. 26). Virginia Cooperative Extension.
description: Whole-grain low-sugar cereal with low-fat milk and banana. A quick, budget-friendly breakfast-for-lunch option. Pack each ingredient separately.
ingredients: 1 cup whole-grain cereal (low sugar, max 7g sugar per serving)
allergen_notes: Contains cereals/gluten (cereal), milk, and nuts (cashews in pack-with). Egg-free, fish-free.
